map.泡沫材料自检：按压缩强度、回弹率、老化后质量变化三项判定: Foam material self-check: judge by three items — compressive strength, resilience, mass change after aging
map.舒适/缓冲：回弹率关系缓冲与脚感: Comfort/cushioning: resilience relates to buffering and feel
map.报告可用性：三项全合格方可用于品质验收: Report usability: all three must pass before quality acceptance
map.逐项判定：压缩强度≥0.3MPa、回弹率≥35%、老化后质量变化率≤5%；三项均: Item-by-item: compressive strength ≥ 0.3 MPa, resilience ≥ 35%, mass change rate after aging ≤ 5%; all three satisfied = pass. Mass change rate reflects aging volatilization/powdering.
map.压缩 0.4MPa（≥0.3 ✓）、回弹 38%（≥35 ✓）、老化质量变化 3: Compression 0.4 MPa (≥0.3 ✓), resilience 38% (≥35 ✓), aging mass change 3% (≤5 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If aging change rate rises to 7% it fails, suggesting powdering.
map.回弹率高低有什么影响？: What is the effect of high or low resilience?
map.回弹率高缓冲恢复好、脚感佳；过低发死、易塌陷。不同用途要求不同，坐垫/鞋材常要求: High resilience gives good cushion recovery and feel; too low feels dead and collapses easily. Requirements differ by use — cushions/footwear often need higher resilience.
map.老化质量变化率为什么控？: Why control the aging mass change rate?
map.变化率大说明材料挥发或粉化严重、寿命短；≤5% 为常见合格上限，具体按产品标准。: A large change rate means severe volatilization or powdering and short life; ≤5% is a common pass upper limit, subject to product standard.
map.压缩试验需按规定速率加载，记录压缩强度: Compression tests require loading at a specified rate and recording compressive strength
